digest.component_or_area: code-review impact model and pass-2 verifier
propositions: Frequency multiplier must amplify-only (never suppress) for serious-tier findings, especially on cold/new files (churn90=0), reshaping the range from [0.5..1.0] to [1.0..1.x]

unversioned_published_contract_break must be gated to TRUE only when a removal lacks a version/deprecation signal (major bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry); managed removals must score FALSE

Pass-2 verifier must add removed_public_symbol (TRUE when finding cites a symbol removed from public API via __all__/re-export/CLI/MCP) and version_signal_present (TRUE when removal carries a deprecation signal) as deterministic sub-answers keyed on EXPORT not caller

impact_code serious-maint lane must apply a deterministic 0.9-tier boost when removed_public_symbol=TRUE AND version_signal_present=FALSE, never lowering existing scores, with boost amplify-only and abstain-safe (default FALSE)

Citric-preregal-ladybird replay (removed PUBLIC API rebar.llm.review_ticket, impact undercount to 0.30) must score >= 0.60 through deletion-impact/api-compat flips after applying removed-public-symbol and version-signal gating

IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must bump code-v4 → code-v5 to segment sidecars; eval-spec dataset gains one fire case (unmanaged removal of exported symbol) and one no-fire case (managed removal with deprecation cycle)
